name: LLMs 6: Fine-tuning and its alternatives
blurb: Pretraining vs fine-tuning vs RAG, datasets and chat templates, LoRA and QLoRA math, DPO, the Hugging Face stack, merging and GGUF conversion, and training on AMD or a rented GPU. Every lesson shows the Python and maths it uses first, step by step. Do LLMs 5 first.
